extensionName.message: Wpp Discreto — Aliases and message protection

extensionDescription.message: Local group aliases and adjustable message blurring for WhatsApp Web.

historyHint.message: The lower area stays readable. Scroll to read older messages there (20% to 100%). Full blur covers the entire conversation.

aliasPlaceholder.message: Name to show in this browser

aliasMatchingHint.message: Chats with identical names share an alias. Search uses the original name.

statusSaveFailed.message: Could not save. Please try again.

statusMissingAlias.message: Enter the original name and alias.

statusLoadFailed.message: Could not load settings. Reopen the extension.

chatLookupHint.message: Reads loaded conversations without moving the list.

chatsUnavailable.message: Open or reload WhatsApp Web in this tab to check names.

aliasNotFound.message: Not found in conversations discovered in this tab. Search again or check the name.

localOnlyNotice.message: Aliases and settings are only visible to you, in this browser. Your messages and original names stay unchanged on WhatsApp.

conversationDataNotice.message: Wpp Discreto does not send or save the contents of your conversations.

resetConfirmDescription.message: Settings will return to their defaults. Your saved aliases will be kept.

mediaOptionsHint.message: Selected types stay fully blurred, including when opened, even with conversation blur off.

mediaFallbackHint.message: If any type is selected, unidentified media will also be blurred.

advancedBlurHelp.message: Selects photos, videos and stickers without changing conversation blur. Adjust each type in settings. Audio stays visible.

deleteConfirmDescription.message: The alias “$ALIAS$” will be removed from this browser. The original WhatsApp name will stay unchanged.

deleteDontAskAgain.message: Do not ask again when removing aliases

chatLookupScope.message: Search includes conversations already loaded in this tab.

unreadCountsHint.message: Blurs the number in the green sidebar badge. WhatsApp notifications stay unchanged.

chatLookupHelpLabel.message: How can I find more conversations?

chatLookupHelp.message: Lookup includes conversations WhatsApp has already loaded in this tab. To include more, close the extension, scroll the WhatsApp conversation list, then click “Find groups and contacts” again. The search field filters only the names found. The extension does not scroll the list for you.
